summary: Repo/static audit PASS for the published V18 Study Library source blob b54ed6324d6f08f94b2116b3dc410d50244699c9. This verifies source-contract correctness only; representative desktop/mobile JavaScript browser acceptance remains unresolved and is already materialized by the existing browser-verification jobs.

findings.evidence: notesPanel renders loading/error/empty states and only maps s.sessions; loadNotes obtains data from PrometeoStudyCalendarV11.courseSessions and stores returned data. No synthetic Clase 01-04 or 'Fecha por definir' sequence is generated; missing title/date fallbacks are capability-honest ('Clase registrada', 'Fecha no registrada').

schedulePanel renders loading/error/empty states from s.events and loadSchedule obtains data from PrometeoStudyCalendarV11.courseSchedule. Invalid/unconfirmed dates are not fabricated into synthetic scheduled events.

Generic login control is rendered disabled with aria-disabled=true and explicit 'No hay un proveedor de autenticación configurado...' title; wireOptions binds menu/theme only and does not alias login to Blackboard or attach a fake login action.
legacyURL is preserved and Version anterior links remain available from options, home/footer, Notas, Cronograma, Más and course footer.

experiment.strategy_effect: Decisive static PASS was made durable and existing browser residuals were referenced rather than creating duplicate verification successors.
